spatial_rules: Staging breaks the camera plane: the two figures sit on a diagonal axis, angled toward each other, one nearer the camera and meaningfully larger in frame, silhouettes slightly overlapping; an out-of-focus environmental element grazes a lower corner in the extreme foreground; readable environment behind; asymmetric negative space above one shoulder line.
identity lock: each figure matches ONLY its own attached identity/muscle card; the previous-panel reference contributes scene continuity ONLY, never a subject's identity, hair or wardrobe
hand accounting: each of the two figures has exactly two hands - four hands total in frame, each attached to its owner
wardrobe lock: Rochelle's garments stay ON with sleeves/coverage as described - her muscle reference's outfit is NOT her wardrobe; muscle size and face only
wardrobe lock: Jill's garments stay ON with coverage as described - her muscle reference's outfit is NOT her wardrobe; muscle size and face only
lighting: Late golden-hour sunlight, the sun low to the left of frame, raking almost parallel across the field so every muscle group is modeled with a full highlight-to-shadow gradient - bright warm gold on lit planes rolling through amber midtone into soft warm shadow; ambient-occlusion one stop deeper where muscle heads meet; a subtle warm rim light wraps from behind with a thin amber edge along shoulders and arms; the environment sits half a stop darker with light haze and dust motes in the low sun shafts.
